tia_content.what: p1 TA01 'Single Supply, 1.5nV/rtHz, Photodiode Amplifier' using the unity-gain LT6200 (not -10): BF862 JFET source follower (1k source resistor) driving -IN, +IN at 2.5 V (10k/10k divider, 0.1 uF), R_F || C_F from output to the JFET gate; V_OUT ~ 2 V + I_PD R_F
tia_content.measured_or_simulated: schematic only, no values or performance

tia_content.what: p1 applications list includes 'Transimpedance Amplifiers'; no TIA design equations, C_F guidance or decompensated-TIA guidance anywhere

application_guidance: Noise equals that of a 56 ohm resistor: keep R_S + R_G||R_F <= 56 ohm for lowest noise; resistor noise dominates 56 ohm-6 kohm, current noise above ~6 kohm (p21). No internal input series resistors; back-to-back input diodes clamp +/-0.7 V, limit continuous diode current to 40 mA (25 ohm per volt of overdrive); 100 ohm in series with each input would raise noise from 0.95 to 2.03 nV/rtHz (p20). Capacitive load (G64 p18, 5 V, A_V = 10): ~20% overshoot at 10 pF with R_S = 0-10 ohm, ~50% at 110 pF with R_S = 0; R_S = 50 ohm gives 15% at 10 pF. Thermal: theta_JA tables, thermal shutdown at 160 C (to ~1.2 mA), restart ~150 C (p21-22).
abs_max_and_input_protection: Total supply 12.6 V; input current +/-40 mA (Note 2: back-to-back diodes, limit current if differential input > 0.7 V); output short-circuit duration indefinite (heat sink may be needed); pin current beyond supplies +/-30 mA transient (ESD diodes to rails, Note 12); T_J 150 C; operating -40 to 85 C; storage -65 to 150 C (p2, p9-10).
other_notes: Open-loop output impedance not given; closed-loop |Z_out| levels at ~20-36 ohm near 100 MHz (G66), which indicates an open-loop output impedance of that order (inference, not a data-sheet value).
Typical-curve GBW at 1 MHz from G67 (+/-5 V): 65.0 dB x 1 MHz = 1.78 GHz versus 1.6 GHz TYP in the table.

Data-sheet inconsistencies: phase margin G62 vs G69 (~7 deg apart); p9 V_OH 20 mA row labelled I_SINK (should be I_SOURCE); p8 'Setting Time' typo; Table 2 p22 titled 'LT6200 8-Lead DD Package' although DD is LT6201-only; HF noise G61 (LT6200-5) and G78 (LT6200-10) are the identical trace; G78 conditions not stated.
G18 noise curve at 10 kHz (1.80 nV/rtHz at 5 V) is higher than the table TYP 1.5 (rev D changed the table values, p25).
